title: Search todo titles
goal: Clients can find items by a word in their title.

acceptance_criteria.text: GET /todos?q=text returns the items whose title contains text, ignoring upper and lower case, in their usual order.
q is trimmed; an empty q returns every item. A q longer than 100 characters is refused with 400.

context.notes: Keep node:http only; no dependencies. Titles may be in any language. Add tests for every acceptance criterion.
